description: Extends F1a wave power model with PTO efficiency vs wave period/height, seawater density correction, directional spreading loss, and device orientation correction.

eta_turbine_peak.description: Wells turbine peak efficiency at design flow coefficient

turbine_bandwidth_s.description: Wells turbine efficiency half-bandwidth around design T_e [s]

eta_turbine_min.description: Minimum turbine efficiency at extreme off-design periods

directional_spread_factor.description: Power reduction from directional spreading (real seas less unidirectional); 0.85-0.95

source: Falnes (2002) Ocean Waves and Oscillating Systems. CUP; Folley (2016) Numerical Modelling of WECs; EMEC TR-001 (2019).
